statements.sql: INSERT INTO "admin_auth_role" ("id", "all_permissions", "assign_first_user", "name", "preset_key") VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT ("preset_key") DO UPDATE SET "all_permissions" = EXCLUDED."all_permissions", "assign_first_user" = EXCLUDED."assign_first_user", "name" = EXCLUDED."name"

WITH "ended" AS (UPDATE "admin_auth_rolepermission" SET "removed_at" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "role_id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "admin_auth_role" WHERE "preset_key" IN ($1) AND "deleted_at" IS NULL) AND "removed_at" IS NULL RETURNING "admin_auth_rolepermission"."permission_id", "admin_auth_rolepermission"."role_id") INSERT INTO "admin_auth_rolepermissionchange" ("changed_by", "kind", "permission_id", "role_id") SELECT $2, $3, "ended"."permission_id", "ended"."role_id" FROM "ended"

DO $w17_warn$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT o."preset_key" AS k, count(*) AS n FROM "admin_auth_role" o JOIN "admin_auth_userrole" h ON h."role_id" = o."id" WHERE o."preset_key" IS NOT NULL AND o."preset_key" NOT IN ('superadmin') AND o."deleted_at" IS NULL AND h."revoked_at" IS NULL GROUP BY o."preset_key" ORDER BY o."preset_key" LOOP RAISE WARNING '%: % (% live holder(s))', 'w17 fixtures: a preset role no longer declared in (w17.acl_roles) is withdrawn (grants ended, sign-up flags cleared) while accounts still hold it. A renamed key withdraws the old role — keep `key`, change `name`. Preset key', r.k, r.n; END LOOP; END $w17_warn$

WITH "ended" AS (UPDATE "admin_auth_rolepermission" SET "removed_at" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "role_id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "admin_auth_role" WHERE "preset_key" IS NOT NULL AND "preset_key" NOT IN ($1) AND "deleted_at" IS NULL) AND "removed_at" IS NULL RETURNING "admin_auth_rolepermission"."permission_id", "admin_auth_rolepermission"."role_id") INSERT INTO "admin_auth_rolepermissionchange" ("changed_by", "kind", "permission_id", "role_id") SELECT $2, $3, "ended"."permission_id", "ended"."role_id" FROM "ended"

UPDATE "admin_auth_role" SET "all_permissions" = $2, "assign_default" = $3, "assign_first_user" = $4 WHERE "id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "admin_auth_role" WHERE "preset_key" IS NOT NULL AND "preset_key" NOT IN ($1) AND "deleted_at" IS NULL) AND (("all_permissions" IS NULL OR "all_permissions" <> $2) OR ("assign_default" IS NULL OR "assign_default" <> $3) OR ("assign_first_user" IS NULL OR "assign_first_user" <> $4))
